note: CIBC Caribbean's Antigua schedule of charges for cards (effective December 2019, last updated September 2026), read in full: the personal cards in Eastern Caribbean dollars and US dollars are written, each with its annual fee for the primary card (none where the schedule gives 0.00; the British Airways Visa Platinum's waived for its first year), its yearly purchase rate, its cash advance rate and 3.50% cash advance fee, its 1.01% foreign transaction fee on the Eastern Caribbean dollar cards, its late payment, over limit and returned cheque fees, and its late payment rate as the penalty rate. The two US dollar cards carry their own fees; their only foreign transaction fee in the schedule is on Barbados dollar transactions, which isn't written. The UWI cards are for the University of the West Indies' students, faculty and alumni, a condition the game doesn't check; the UWI rewards card's waiver for faculty isn't written. The commercial and business cards aren't written; nor are the replacement card, statement, rush card, emergency payment and auto-payment charges, which a holder meets only by asking or by an auto-payment. The schedule states no minimum payment or grace period for the personal cards. Wave 4 (30 October 2026) looked for more banks and added none: the RBC Caribbean credit card pages, rendered, list no personal card for the Eastern Caribbean, only business cards; Antigua Commercial Bank's site answered with a captcha and the Eastern Caribbean Amalgamated Bank's home page links no card terms.
